hero.intro: Helix24 creates logos, brand identities, website designs and video content that help growing businesses look as good as the work they do.
hero.whatsappMessage: Hi Helix24, I would like to discuss branding and design.

servicesSection.title: What we design
servicesSection.intro: Start with a logo, or bring us in for your full brand, website and content.

contact.title: Tell us about your brand
contact.text: Share what you have today and where you want to go. We will reply within 24 hours.

services.title: Logo & Brand Identity
services.text: A logo, colour palette and type choices that work everywhere: on your signboard, website, Instagram and invoices.

services.title: Brand Guidelines
services.text: A short guide showing how to use your logo, colours and tone, so everything your team produces looks consistent.

services.title: Website & App Design (UI/UX)
services.text: Page and screen designs in Figma, built around what your customers need to find and do.

services.title: Reels & Video Ads
services.text: Short vertical videos and motion graphics for Instagram, Facebook and YouTube Shorts, planned around a clear opening hook.

services.title: Social Media Creatives
services.text: Post, carousel and ad designs in your brand style, ready for organic posting or paid campaigns.

services.title: Print & Packaging
services.text: Business cards, brochures, signage and packaging that match the rest of your brand.

faqs.q: How long does a logo and brand identity take?
faqs.a: Usually 2 to 3 weeks, including first concepts, your feedback and final files. A full brand guide can add another week.
Your logo in vector (SVG, PDF, AI) and image formats (PNG, JPG), in colour, black and white versions, plus your colour codes and fonts.

faqs.q: Do you also make video content for Instagram?
faqs.a: Yes. We script, edit and design Reels and short video ads, and can run them as part of our social media marketing service.
